verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed docs.lium.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Lium summary, and lium.io/llms.txt carries agent-directed instructions. The docs also offer raw markdown for every page (via `.md` or `Accept: text/markdown`), a dedicated agents guide, an agent SKILL.md, and an MCP doc-search endpoint, so an agent can be pointed at docs built for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.lium.io/llms.txt # Lium Documentation
The user asks what a GPU costs to rent right now or which GPUs are available: read the public prices below, no account.
Add `.md` to any page URL for raw markdown (e.g. [`/providers/quickstart.md`](/providers/quickstart)), or send `Accept: text/markdown`.
An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
Use the MCP server at `/mcp` to search and read the docs (`search`, `read_page`)
